extraction_fields.definition: true only if the bidder itself states that it holds an Ontario electrical contractor licence. false if the proposal says the electrical work will be done by a subcontractor or other third party, or that the licence is pending or will be obtained. null if licensing is not mentioned.
the licence number exactly as written.
true if the bidder states it holds WSIB clearance. false if it states it does not. null if not mentioned.
the liability insurance amount in CAD as a plain number. null if no amount is stated.
the number of completed commercial installations the proposal states.
the smallest system size, in kW, that the proposal says those installations cover.
the earliest year the proposal states for those installations (for example from 'since 2021'). null if no year is stated.
the total price in CAD. If several prices appear, use the total all-in price. If no single total is stated, null.
time from award to completion. unit is "weeks", "days" or "months".
the panel or equipment warranty length in years.
the workmanship warranty length in years.
true if the proposal says a named project lead or manager will run the project. false if it says one will be assigned later. null if not mentioned.
the number of crew members stated.
true if the proposal states that it includes a site safety plan.
true if the proposal states that it includes performance monitoring.
the monitoring period in months, if stated.

mandatory.label: Ontario electrical contractor licence held by the bidder
